mod_appeal.intro: When a moderator removes something you own, it appears here with the reason. Content stays recoverable for a limited time — submit an appeal to ask a moderator to restore it before it is permanently deleted.
mod_appeal.load_error_hint: Something went wrong reaching the server. Check your connection.

admin_takedowns.title: Takedowns
admin_takedowns.lead: When staff remove a group or page, the owner is notified and can appeal. Restore appealed or mistaken removals here, and control whether un-appealed takedowns are ever permanently deleted.
admin_takedowns.toggle_hint_pre: When on, content still under a takedown past its window is
admin_takedowns.toggle_hint_post: deleted by the hourly worker. When off (the default), nothing is ever auto-deleted — owners keep the ability to appeal indefinitely.
admin_takedowns.warning: Irreversible. Once enabled, groups and pages whose owners never appealed within the retention window are permanently removed — their posts and memberships cannot be recovered.
admin_takedowns.retention_hint: Days an owner has to appeal before a takedown can be purged.
admin_takedowns.reminder_hint: Send the owner a “final reminder” this many days before deletion.
